meta.source: EDUcore Education Standards Knowledge Graph (educore-standards MCP connector)
meta.equivalenceRule: EdFi value -EXACT_MATCH-> CEDS HubReference <-CLOSE_MATCH- LIF value; confidence is the LIF-side CLOSE_MATCH score
meta.notes: Candidate-quality (one hop is inferred). See README.md for the Cypher.
meta.propertiesNote: properties are INFERRED, not authored in EDUcore: an Ed-Fi property and a LIF property are proposed as equivalent when their option sets share CEDS value hubs. EDUcore has no property-level LIF matches (0 EXACT/CLOSE on LIF DmeProperty as of 2026-09-08). Confidence = mean value-row confidence for the set pair.
